text:
alex: Heads up — repro'd a latency spike on staging when kernel fallback triggers for Mistral-7B. At ~512 tokens p50 jumps ~2x. Batch sizes small (2-4). Stack looks like: continuous-batcher -> kernel-selector -> fallback to generic matmul kernel. cc @maria @sam
perf-bot: perf-alert: p50 latency increased 2.1x on rtdb-staging (zone us-east1). Spike started at 2026-03-17T14:23:10Z
maria: Can you paste the profiler output? curious about KV cache misses / page evictions.
alex: ```
profiler summary:
model: mistral-7b
seq: 512
batch: 2
p50: 86ms -> 190ms
kernel: heur chosen = fused_attn_gqa (fallback -> matmul_generic)
kv_cache_misses: 12% -> 48%
paged_frag: 0.12 -> 0.47
num_kv_heads: 16
kv_dim_per_head: 128
```
sam: That paged_frag jump looks like cache fragmentation when we pass from GQA->MQA mapping. Are we reflattening KV layout on kernel change? Might be double-copying causing stalls.
charlie: Also check RoPE scale table. Mistral was using RoPE scale modifier at inference for long seqs; scaling can blow up memory layout leading to misaligned vectorization on some kernels.
alex: Confirmed: when kernel-selector switches to matmul_generic we also switch to contiguous KV layout (copy) because matmul expects interleaved heads. That copy happens on CPU path -> stalls GPU. Repro cmd: `./bin/repro --model mistral7b --seq 512 --batch 2 --trace`
maria: Options:
- prefer_hint kernel 'fused_attn_smallseq' up to 1024 tokens
- change batching heuristic: only allow fallback if batch>8
- reuse interleaved layout for matmul_generic to avoid copy (needs kernel change)
sam: We tried reuse-layout patch before — reduced p50 but throughput dropped ~8% for high-concurrency. Might be worth A/B: fix latency for low-batch interactive workloads.
charlie: About num_kv_heads: switching to MQA (num_kv_heads=8 kv_dim=256) vs GQA (16x128) changes fanout on GEMM. For Qwen we had similar, kernel choice must know (heads,kv_dim) pair or will misselect kernels. We should add metric 'kv_layout_mismatch' to profiler.
jordan: Assigning follow-up: alex + maria to run comparative bench: (a) prefer_hint + no-copy layout (b) batching threshold tweak. Jordan will schedule 2-hour experiment window tomorrow. @perf-bot please create a perf job.
perf-bot: perf-job created: job/2101112223-kernel-fallback-abtest scheduled 2026-03-18T10:00Z
maria: Quick config snippet I'm going to test in staging:
```
runtime:
  kernel_hint:
    prefer: fused_attn_smallseq
    max_seq: 1024
  batching:
    min_batch_for_fallback: 8
  kv:
    preserve_interleaved_layout: true
```
alex: If preserve_interleaved_layout is true we avoid the CPU copy but codepath for matmul_generic needs to accept interleaved. I'll prototype a shim that interprets layout at kernel entry.
sam: :thumbsup: Keep notes about RoPE scaling — if we change kv_dim head mapping we might need to update RoPE offsets. Small followup: test with qwen-7b and mixtral-8x8 to verify generality.
charlie: One more: paged KV fragmentation metrics suggest we should trigger a compaction during low-load windows. I'll open a small RFC for adaptive compaction.
alex: Great. I'll push an initial patch to enable kernel hinting + layout flag behind feature-flag 'kv-layout-hint' and post results in this thread.
